description: This is a C source file implementing configuration data handling for a build system, including functions for file existence checks, directory creation, dependency management, configuration reading/writing, and symbol management.

methods.name: conf_warning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with filename and line number context.

methods.name: conf_message
methods.description: Outputs a formatted message via a callback.

methods.name: conf_get_configname
methods.description: Returns the current configuration filename or default.

methods.name: conf_get_autoconfig_name
methods.description: Returns the auto configuration filename or default.

methods.name: conf_get_autoheader_name
methods.description: Returns the auto header filename or default.

methods.name: conf_get_rustccfg_name
methods.description: Returns the rustc config filename or default.

methods.name: conf_set_sym_val
methods.description: Sets the value of a symbol based on input string.

methods.name: conf_read_simple
methods.description: Reads configuration from a file into symbols.

methods.name: conf_read
methods.description: Reads and processes configuration, updating symbol states.

methods.name: conf_write
methods.description: Writes the current configuration to a file.

methods.name: conf_write_autoconf
methods.description: Generates dependency files and configuration headers.

methods.name: conf_set_changed
methods.description: Sets the changed state of the configuration.

methods.name: conf_get_changed
methods.description: Returns whether the configuration has unsaved changes.

methods.name: conf_set_changed_callback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked when changed state updates.

methods.name: set_all_choice_values
methods.description: Sets all non-assigned choice values to 'no'.
